bio.text: Alan Bradstock is the Democratic nominee for Pennsylvania's 14th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the May 19, 2026 primary.
Ballotpedia lists military service in the U.S. Army, and in his Candidate Connection survey responses he describes himself as a Desert Storm veteran and U.S. Army aviation officer.
In the same responses he says he is a retired FBI agent from Western Pennsylvania who led investigations into public corruption, terrorism and violent crime.
